correctness.rationale: For each selected original-vertex clique X in G, subdivision vertices are forced into the independent dominating set exactly for edges of G-X. An unselected original vertex v is undominated precisely when N_G(v)=X. This proves the bijection with cliques outside the set of distinct simplicial neighborhoods and proves every coefficient, including isolates. The triangle-free and multipartite corollaries follow from exact clique types. An adjacency-based brute-force checker agreed for 75 labelled graphs through order four, 20 additional seeded connected graphs, and all reported corollary tests; its full implementation is included.

value.rationale: A complete all-set structural classification for every finite base graph is substantially stronger than a minimum-size parameter. The simplicial-neighborhood correction identifies exactly why some cliques fail, and yields the shape-independent total count 1+n+m and degree-based polynomial over all triangle-free graphs with minimum degree two, and a part-size polynomial with sharp singleton exceptions for every complete multipartite graph. The object and cardinality polynomial are standard independent-domination invariants, not arbitrary finite constructions; no claim of polynomial-time computation is made.
